comment_operator.input_required: one public or authorized comment plus its URL, time and platform policy context

reply_blueprints.structure: acknowledge the exact question → answer only what evidence supports → link the source only if useful
surface the hidden decision trade-off → add one new source-bound detail → invite a specific counterexample
state the correction calmly → show the evidence boundary → preserve the person's dignity

sequence: include a link only when the answer remains useful without it
stop if moderators or community members signal mismatch

partner_growth_protocol.minimum_joint_asset: one co-owned useful artifact with explicit contribution, rights, measurement and exit terms
